title: The finite completed Chern equation with shared concrete endpoints
statement: For l prime, Y with surface localization conventions, Chern data c, restriction r, normalized coefficients k, a derived-limit model L, n natural and delta:diagonalCompletedDomain(l,Y)→diagonalCompletedCodomain(l,Y), finiteChernEquation means completedBoundaryEquation for U=diagonalCompletedUnderlying(l,surface(Y)), g=single(completedSupportedUnit(l,Y)), the given delta, z=shiftedComparison(U,D(r.F)⋙L.R,k.lineMap(L),2)≫L.projection(n), and v=finiteChernComposite(l,surface(Y),c,r,k,L,n,diagonalPic(Y)). This names exactly the original finite completed diagonal Chern equality; it is a predicate definition, not a new proof obligation.

def finiteChernEquation (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y) c r)
    (L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))) (n : ℕ)
    (delta : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y) : Prop
